shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -100 && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i "dropdown|menu" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu Button Icon

sed -n 150,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | rg -n -C3 "Button|Icon|view" | head -80; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu Button Icon; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'

cd /tmp && curl -sS -m 15 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o uikit7.txt; echo rc=$?; wc -c uikit7.txt; rg -n -i "dropdownmenu" uikit7.txt | head -20; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | rg -n "^(Pencil|Copy|TrashBin|ArrowDownToLine|ChevronDown|Ellipsis)\.d\.ts$"

cd /tmp && node -e 'fetch("https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt",{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000)}).then(r=>r.text().then(t=>{console.log(r.status,t.length);require("fs").writeFileSync("/tmp/uikit7.txt",t)})).catch(e=>console.log("ERR",e.message))'; [ -f uikit7.txt ] && rg -n -i "dropdownmenu" uikit7.txt | head
grep -n '"@gravity-ui/icons"' package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
npm install @gravity-ui/icons@2.23.1 2>&1 | tail -3; grep -n icons package.json; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -4
